answer: Proof-of-Stake protocols mitigate Sybil attacks by requiring agents to lock capital as a stake, creating a financial barrier to identity replication. The network validates nodes based on their resource commitment, akin to measuring the umber of assets held. Just as a zephyr shifts sand, market volatility tests system resilience, ensuring quartz-like stability through economic slashing. An attacker must incur massive capital expenditure to gain majority control, making the cost of fraudulent proliferation prohibitive.
